title: Merchandise – tote bags
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose which identity a person should carry on a piece of merchandise. A bag offers enough space for a single strong identifier.
strategic_value: The museum family can support both a shared museum souvenir and a Weston Park Museum souvenir.
demonstration: A dark green bag carries the white museum seal. A yellow bag with matching handles carries the dark Weston Park Museum lettering and its framing device.
practical_value: Choose the seal for a museum-wide bag or the venue lettering for a venue-specific bag. Judge scale against the bag body.

content_islands.name: Institutional bag
content_islands.spec: Center the white circular seal on the green body, leaving open material around it. Keep the handles visible.

content_islands.name: Venue bag
content_islands.spec: Match the first bag’s size. Center the framed Weston Park lettering on the yellow body and align the bag bases for comparison.
